name: The General Hospital
archetype: An acute-care teaching hospital — medicine, surgery, emergency, diagnostics

ca.what: Funding, oversight and performance accountability of hospitals under accountability agreements.
Accreditation of hospital quality and safety against national standards through periodic on-site surveys.
Outbreak surveillance, infection-prevention-and-control guidance and public-health emergency coordination.

roles.title: Board of Governors
roles.about: Appointed to govern the hospital in the public interest. Approves strategy, budgets and quality goals, credentials the medical staff on the advice of the Chief of Staff, and holds the CEO to account. Works through its Quality & Patient Safety, Audit & Finance and Governance & Nominating committees.
acc: Ultimate accountability for the quality and safety of care delivered in the hospital
Approval of strategy, operating and capital budgets
Appointment and performance of the CEO and credentialing of the medical staff

roles.title: Chief of Staff & Chief Medical Officer
roles.about: A practising physician appointed to lead the medical staff. Accountable directly to the Board of Governors for the quality of medical care; chairs the Medical Advisory Committee and oversees credentialing, privileges and physician performance.
acc: Quality of medical care delivered by the credentialed medical staff
